release: bp05mr24 (2024-03-05 public forecast zone / county correlation)
license_or_access: Public NOAA/NWS access; U.S. Government work, no license asserted by the provider.
units: One row per (public forecast zone polygon, county) correlation pair; no measured quantity.
timezone_conversion: None; the file carries no timestamps. The TIME_ZONE column is a static county attribute and is not used.
filters: None. All 4793 correlation rows are retained verbatim and in source order, so a bundle in a state the corpus has not used yet is decided by the file rather than refused for its absence.
grid_index_mapping: No gridded index used. FIPS is the five-digit county FIPS; STATE_ZONE is the NWS zone id (e.g. MN060).

verification.notes: HTTP 200, Content-Length 339683 bytes, sha256 recomputed from the response body. The eleven pipe-delimited columns (STATE|ZONE|CWA|NAME|STATE_ZONE|COUNTY|FIPS|TIME_ZONE|FE_AREA|LAT|LON) were checked field-for-field against the NWS Zone-County Correlation File page (https://www.weather.gov/gis/ZoneCounty). 4793 non-empty rows parsed, all eleven columns present in every row, and every retained line byte-compared against its source line.

uncertainty: The slice is a single dated release (2024-03-05). NWS zone geometry changes over time, so reports from earlier years (the corpus spans 2018-2024) are correlated against the 2024 zone definitions. Earlier releases were not retrieved, so whether any zone used here changed county membership during that span is unverified.
